name: iwram_divmod_rom
comment: ROM copy of IWRAM 0x03000220 (iwram_divmod)

name: copy32
comment: ARM copy of n>>5 32-byte blocks (ldm/stm); used by obj_upload_tiles

name: copy32_rom
comment: ROM copy of IWRAM 0x03000298 (copy32)

name: minimap_window_copy
comment: ARM: 64x64 window of the 4bpp map into 64 OBJ tiles; byte shift with masks 0x087F5CE8

name: minimap_window_copy_rom
comment: ROM copy of IWRAM 0x03004b98 (minimap_window_copy)

name: hud_reset_mode0
comment: objects 0/14 frame = language; 32 = language+1 in km/h; hides message element 46 (modes 0/1)

name: hud_reset_mode3
comment: as hud_reset_mode0 (mode 3)

name: hud_reset_mode2
comment: as hud_reset_mode0 but hides message element 54 (mode 2)

name: hud_hunter_bars
comment: hunter mode: two bar objects per racer from hunter life (driver +0x4E8)

name: hud_countdown_timer
comment: (not called by the HUD modes) countdown *0x03006154 - race time; race state 7 at zero

name: hud_best_lap
comment: (tentative; not called by the HUD modes) best lap driver +0xB4 or the profile record time as digits

name: hud_message_cancel
comment: stops a message and hides its element

name: hud_toggle
comment: 1: hud_reset; else hides every object; then hud_message_hide (pause 0 / continue 1)

name: hud_message_show_default
comment: hud_message_show(msg

name: hud_message_show_player
comment: hud_message_show(msg
column6: 0) when the entity is the player (*0x03000060)

name: hud_message_force_player
comment: hud_message_show(msg
column6: 1) when the entity is the player

name: hud_message2_player
comment: hud_message_show(2
column6: 0) when the entity is the player

name: hud_units_frame
comment: (tentative; not called by the HUD modes) a units panel frame by language

name: hud_message_entry
comment: message table entry: 0x087F437D (modes 0/1) / 0x087F43FD (2) / 0x087F43BD (3) + 4*msg

name: obj_tile_address
comment: 0x06010000 + 32*(tile + *0x030064E0) when DISPCNT OBJ 1-D mapping; else 0

name: obj_palette_write
comment: copies n colours to OBJ palette RAM from index k (-1 when out of range)
